sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

You pointed to copper and labour costs, and Option B answers that directly: we carry the copper risk above the deadband through an index clause, so the base price needs no risk premium for it.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your committee a clear, single-step decision with no clause to administer, and the payment term it offers is longer than the one in your Angebot. The quality record also supports it:

On quality:
Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 361.85; payment 90 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 361.72; payment 90 days net; index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08).

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Option B is there if you prefer the index mechanism.

If your pricing committee needs anything to decide, such as a one-page summary of the options, we will gladly prepare it. For the committee, Option A is one clear proposal on a single unit price and payment term, without an index clause to administer. Please take Option A to the committee on that basis.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
